title: Hertfordshire police admit unlawful arrest of couple in school WhatsApp row – report
summary: Force said to have agreed to £20,000 payout to parents who complained about daughter’s school in Borehamwood A police force has reportedly admitted it unlawfully arrested two parents in front of their nine-year-old daughter after they complained about her school on WhatsApp. Rosalind Levine and her partner, Maxie Allen, said they were held at a police station for 11 hours over the complaints about their daughter’s primary school.
